_doc: Delivery-availability overrides for KG instructors. The KG ranks on topic/credibility and cannot know who Acceler can ACTUALLY staff. This file encodes that human knowledge. 'pre_sales_only' = strong proposal/marquee credibility but NOT reliably staffable for delivery (post-sales). The /instructors command MUST exclude these from any post-sales / deliverable shortlist, and may still list them for pre-sales proposal credibility — clearly labelled 'pre-sales only'. Keep this list updated as engagements succeed or fall through.
